datasheet_identity.title: ES2A THRU ES2J SURFACE MOUNT FAST RECOVERY RECTIFIER (SMA/DO-214AC)

extraction_notes: Source PDF SHA-256 verified: d0c8b65118a0ad631758c21f543007272f63cbc8913b901350d507265f357009 (C18199140__ES2G.pdf, ES2A THRU ES2J datasheet, Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd, Rev:1.1).

ES2G column values: VRRM=400 V, VRMS=280 V, VDC=400 V (maximum ratings, page 1); VF max 1.3 V @ IF=2.0 A (ES2E/ES2G column group); CJ typ 17 pF (ES2E/ES2G column group); Trr max 35 ns, IR1 max 5.0 uA @ 25 degC, IR2 max 100 uA @ 125 degC span the whole ES2A-ES2J row (page 2).

IR2 = 100 uA maximum at VR=VDC=400 V, TA=125 degC (page 2 table) could not be stored in the single reverse_current slot; the 25 degC IR1 value was kept as primary. The 125 degC typical behavior is captured by the Fig.4 Tj=125 degC digitized curve.

breakdown_voltage/breakdown_current set to null: the datasheet specifies VRRM/VDC maximum ratings (400 V for ES2G) but no measured breakdown voltage (V(BR)) test condition or breakdown current; ratings were not recast as breakdown specs.

Other maximum ratings (page 1, Ta=25 degC unless otherwise specified): IF(AV)=2.0 A @ 60 Hz sinewave resistive load referenced to TL per Fig.1; IFSM=50.0 A @ t=8.3 ms half-sine; Tstg=-55 to +150 degC; Tj=-55 to +150 degC; RthJ-A=65 degC/W typ, RthJ-L=20 degC/W typ.

Curves digitized by pixel-tracing a 300 dpi render of page 2 with axis frames calibrated to labeled ticks and gridline rows/columns masked. Fig.3: the dashed middle curve of three (legend ES2E-ES2G) was extracted; sanity check: digitized typical VF at ~2 A (~1.25 V interpolated) sits below the 1.3 V table maximum. Fig.2 digitized 49.7 A at N=1 matches the 50 A IFSM rating.

Fig.1, Fig.2, and Fig.4 are single family-wide curves (no per-type split); Fig.4 x-axis is normalized to percent of rated peak reverse voltage, so 100% corresponds to 400 V for ES2G. Fig.1 derating breakpoint digitized at TL~135 degC with linear fall to 0 A at 150 degC.
Polarity: cathode line (band) denotes the cathode end; SMA/DO-214AC package. Device marking code: ES2G.
No usable curves omitted; page 3 contains only ordering information, package outline, and pad layout (mechanical, not extracted as specs).
